task.description: Implement OBS-01 structured logging in Zig per src/design/obs-01-structured-logging.md. Add the shared logger module and any required runtime wiring so platform log output is single-line JSON to stdout with required fields timestamp, level, trace_id, component, and message. Enforce BPM_LOG_LEVEL parsing with fatal startup failure on invalid values, preserve API-09 trace propagation for request logs, generate trace IDs for scheduler or timer background work, and redact sensitive values such as tokens, credentials, and password fields to [REDACTED]. Do not introduce audit-log persistence in this step. Validate with the required backend commands and complete the handoff with produced artifacts and any issues.
acceptance_criteria: OBS-01 acceptance criteria are implemented in backend code with no schema regressions
zig build exits 0 and the required backend validation commands succeed
All emitted log entries use the required structured JSON field set
Invalid BPM_LOG_LEVEL causes fatal startup validation failure
Request and background logs carry the correct trace_id behavior and sensitive values are redacted

result.summary: Implemented OBS-01 structured logging with a shared JSON logger, strict BPM_LOG_LEVEL validation, request logging on health routes, and background trace-aware scheduler logging.
